Prime Series

Stryker's hospital stretchers

Our Prime Series stretchers are designed to reduce physical strain on clinicians, enhance comfort during patient transport and drive hospital efficiency. Transporting heavier patients in a hospital gurney is now easier with Stryker's advanced mobility, while electric functionality gives patients the independence to adjust themselves without calling for caregiver assistance. Fully equipped and highly configurable, our Prime Series stretchers allow you to create a solution that meets your specific needs.

text.text:
The cost of falls

Noisy, chaotic and fast-paced—the emergency department never stops. With more patients and fewer nurses1, it can be challenging to not only set bed exit, but also to locate the right stretcher when an alarm is activated. And those actions have serious consequences.

Every year, nearly 1 million patients in the US experience a fall at the hospital2, with a significant number of these falls likely occurring in the emergency department. In addition to the devastating impact of lives lost, a fall can cost up to $32,2153 per episode of injury and take a serious toll on care team morale.

But falls don’t have to be the norm.

text_copy.text:
The Prime difference
Transforming patient care with connectivity, advanced mobility and electric functionality

The demands on caregivers have never been greater — heavier patients, longer transports, ever-growing time constraints, patient falls, and an expectation to perform with fewer hands on deck. At Stryker, we are driven to help healthcare professionals achieve their goals by providing the Prime solution to address their needs. Through advanced mobility, electric functionality and pressure redistribution surfaces; Prime Series stretchers are designed to help ensure caregiver safety and efficiency while enhancing the patient experience.

text.text:
Prime Connect
Smart stretcher. Confident care.

With both visual and audible bed exit alarms, Prime Connect is a smart, connected stretcher designed to help support fall prevention protocols in your facility.

text_copy.text:
Designed to support both caregivers and patients

With its advanced mobility, electric functionality and pressure redistribution surfaces, Prime Connect helps prioritize caregiver safety and efficiency while also enhancing the overall patient experience.

curatedcta_copy_copy.subtitle: Improved local monitoring
curatedcta_copy_copy.description: Local monitoring capabilities make it easy to acknowledge bed exit alarms in loud, fast-paced environments with the ability to have both the corridor light and the enhanced footboard display illuminate when bed exit is triggered.
curatedcta_copy_copy.CTAImageAltText: Local monitoring fixture lit up on wall

curatedcta_copy_copy.subtitle: Wired notifications
curatedcta_copy_copy.description: Plug Prime Connect into your existing nurse call system to enable the transmission of bed exit through the nurse call system itself. This connection can illuminate the dome light when bed exit is triggered.
curatedcta_copy_copy.CTAImageAltText: Prime Connect electric hospital stretcher showing wire plugged into wall

text_copy_copy.text:
Safety. Support. Features.

Our Prime Connect and Prime Series stretchers are built for safety and support with caregivers and patients in mind.

standaloneimage_copy.alt: Prime Connect electric hospital stretcher footboard

text.text:
Enhanced footboard display

Includes a high-contrast screen that offers a user friendly experience. Tailored bed exit alarms align with patient fall risk status and hospital auditory preferences.

standaloneimage.alt: Zoom motorized drive virtually eliminates manual pushing on electric hospital stretchers

text.text:
Advanced stretcher mobility

Zoom motorized drive virtually eliminates manual pushing, while Big Wheel reduces start-up push force and steering.

standaloneimage_copy.alt: Close up of Prime Series big wheel electric lift

text.text:
Electric lift pedal

Eliminates manual pumping, allowing for quick patient access. Simply step on the hydraulic pedal to raise the litter.

standaloneimage_copy.alt: Nurse activating list assist for hospital stretcher

text.text:
Lift Assist backrest

The drop seat leverages the patient’s weight to easily raise the head of the stretcher, while cradling the patient to reduce the need for boosting.

standaloneimage_copy.alt: Close up of Prime Series stretcher four-sided brakes

text.text:
Simple and convenient

Four-sided brakes offer convenient access, while a power-washable design makes Prime Series stretchers easy to clean in a fast-paced healthcare environment.

standaloneimage_copy.alt: Prime Series hospital stretcher in recovery chair position

text.text:
Recovery chair position

Helps eliminate the need for unnecessary transfers by providing a comfortable position for patients to recover.

standaloneimage_copy.alt: Prime Series IsoFlex SE get support surface

text.text:
IsoFlex SE gel support surface

IsoFlex SE addresses two key risk factors for skin breakdown: pressure and shear. Equipped with ShearGel throughout the entire surface and CoreGel in the sacral region, IsoFlex SE helps to keep the patient comfortable, aids in the treatment and prevention of pressure ulcers.**

standaloneimage_copy.alt: patient using thumb to control bed position

text.text:
Comfort controls

Patients can control their own comfort instead of calling for assistance and repositioning. Controls are staggered so the patient can access them in any position, and they include a patient lock-out. Optional foot-end nursing controls allow caregivers to improve patient comfort with the touch of a button.

standaloneimage_copy.alt: Close up of Prime Series side rails

text.text:
Glideaway siderails

These siderails offer enhanced patient security when raised.
